entities.name: Lucius Aemilius Mamercinus Privernas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lucius Aemilius Mamercinus Privernas was a Roman statesman who served as the consul in 341 and 329 BC, Magister Equitum in 342, Dictator in 335 and 316, and Interrex in 326.
